title: OCX Catalog Configuration
description: catalog.config.json — configures an @ocx-sh/catalog deployment (data sources, branding, nav, CI). See src/config/load.ts for the runtime validation contract this schema documents; validation itself is hand-rolled, not ajv-driven.

$schema.description: Editor/tooling pointer at this schema. Never read at runtime.

sources.description: One or more index sources this catalog renders (path/url/git, discriminated per entry — see sourceEntry). At most one entry may set root: true, serving that source's wire tree at the site root as well as under index/<label>/. At most one entry may set default: true, the index the catalog view opens on — a separate question from root, and the only way to name a default when no source is root at all. Both checks live in allOf because one schema object can hold only one contains.

brand.description: Site branding: title (required), and optional wordmark/logo. Drives <title>, og:site_name, and the header.

nav.description: Extra top-nav links, rendered after the built-in Docs entry when docs is set.

footer.description: Footer links, rendered in place of nav[] (a dedicated key, not a reuse of nav[]). Omit for a footer with only the raw-data link.

docs.description: Single docs directory, resolved relative to this file's directory.

docsNav.description: Labelled entries for the docs-mount link(s) in the top nav, replacing the single auto "docs" entry. Requires docs to be set. Omit for one auto entry labelled "docs" pointing at /docs/.

css.description: Custom stylesheet, resolved relative to this file's directory.

publicDir.description: Static assets directory, resolved relative to this file's directory. Copied verbatim into VitePress's publicDir, served at the site root.

ci.description: CI workflow rendering configuration for `ocx-catalog ci` — forge (github/gitlab), package manager, and whether to render the verification job.

siteUrl.description: Deployment origin (e.g. https://index.ocx.sh), feeding sitemap.hostname and per-page og:url. Must be an absolute http(s) URL — src/config/load.ts validates the shape beyond what this schema (minLength only) expresses.

description.description: Site-wide tagline/meta description, distinct from brand.title.

favicon.description: Site-root-relative href for the browser-tab icon, e.g. /favicon.svg for a favicon.svg shipped via publicDir. Emitted as <link rel="icon"> on every page, with type derived from the extension (.svg/.png/.ico). Omit for no icon link.

sourceEntry.description: Exactly one of path | url | git, discriminated by which key is present.

url.description: Base URL of a deployed catalog/index instance. https only — /config.json and /c/index.json are the only fetched files that are never digest-verified, so over plain http a network attacker rewrites the enumeration and every downstream digest check then verifies against their digests. src/config/load.ts enforces the same rule with new URL() + a protocol check.

defaultSourceEntry.description: Matches a sources[] entry declaring default: true, for the array-level contains/maxContains check that caps the count at one. minContains: 0 keeps a config with zero default entries legal — the root: true source, if any, is then the default.

rootSourceEntry.description: Matches a sources[] entry declaring root: true, for the array-level contains/maxContains check that caps the count at one. minContains: 0 keeps a config with zero root entries legal.

wordmark.description: Header wordmark — the text beside the logo in the site header. Omit to show title there too.

logo.description: Logo asset, relative to this file's directory (a local path, never a URL). Copied into the site's public root and rendered in the header in place of the theme's built-in mark. Omit to keep the built-in mark.

text.description: Visible label for this nav entry.

link.description: Target href — an http(s) URL or a site-relative path. Validated at config-load time against the same allowlist the theme's safeHref uses before render.

text.description: Visible label for this docs-nav entry.

link.description: Target href — must be "/docs/" or start with "/docs/"; anything else is a nav[] entry with extra steps.

links.description: Footer links, same shape and validation as nav[].

ci.description: Unknown keys inside ci are ignored (forward-compat) — this is the one object in the config that is NOT additionalProperties: false.

packageManager.description: Package manager the rendered workflow's install/exec steps use. npm (default) or bun only — pnpm/yarn are unsupported, so a mismatched value is a loud config-load error rather than a silently broken rendered workflow.
